about: The twelve screens of the project universe. Edit a title, category, year or line here, or set image to a file under public/projects/art/ (e.g. "art/identity.jpg"; a landscape picture, it is cover-cropped into the right of the screen), then run: python tools/reskin_s4.py. Set url to make the screen a link that opens that site in a new tab (read at runtime, no re-run needed). Leave year empty to show the category alone. Screens without a real project show what the owner builds (category AI, Automation, 3D or Web draws a matching motif). The ids are fixed: they name the measured screen each project sits on (p03 is the hero screen, p05-p09 the small far row, p11/p12 the near flanks).
